acceptance.given: The NFR-2 auditability verification is configured with an isolated binding-deletion fixture, an independent witness identity, and a control-input fingerprint covering every input other than the deleted binding.

oracle.expected: The verification produces and records an evidence-invalid outcome bound to that fixture, witness identity, and unchanged control-input fingerprint.
forbidden: Any control input besides the binding is changed.
The witness record is missing, non-independent, unbound to the fixture, or reports acceptance.
The evidence-invalid result cannot be traced to the isolated fixture and unchanged inputs.
oracle.observable: The verifier output or persisted receipt contains the evidence-invalid decision, binding-deletion fixture identifier, independent-witness identifier, and unchanged control-input fingerprint.

acceptance.then: An independently witnessed, fixture-bound evidence-invalid auditability result is available for review.
acceptance.when: The NFR-2 missing-trace verification executes the binding-deletion case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the binding-deletion fixture with its independent witness field absent or invalid; the auditability verifier must reject the case as evidence-invalid.
Select a witness receipt whose control-input fingerprint differs from the isolated binding-deletion fixture; the verifier must reject the mismatched binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the replay/evaluation verification surface with a deterministic NFR-2 missing-trace probe that deletes only the binding, preserves all other inputs, requires an independent witness, and records an evidence-invalid result with fixture and input provenance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing replay and validation command interfaces and receipt schemas; the change adds scoped auditability verification and preserves historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Configured binding-deletion fixture -> verifier executes with unchanged control inputs and independent witness -> evidence-invalid result is recorded with fixture and provenance bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The obligation is satisfied only when the isolated binding-deletion case is independently witnessed and deterministically recorded as evidence-invalid; missing witness data or altered control inputs fail closed.
